paper_title: From Privacy-Only to Simulatable OT: Black-Box, Round-Optimal, Information-Theoretic
statement: It remains an open problem to find a similar transform (with the same properties) starting with any 2-round OT protocol satisfying only privacy against semi-honest (rather than defensible) receivers. Also, it would be interesting to find simple constructions of 2-round OT protocols in the plain model that are private against defensible receivers, and that rely on hardness assumptions from which we do not know how to obtain 2-round OT protocols that are private against malicious receivers (e.g., CDH, LPN, and Subset Sum).
